tools.name: decision.setup
tools.description: Record the decision registry, resident slots, and router argv. Does not start a server.

tools.name: decision.check
tools.description: Check the recorded decision registry against the catalog and this host.

tools.name: decision.models
tools.description: List decision models and compound models. Does not read weight files.

tools.name: decision.call
tools.description: Run one decision model or a compound model through the decision router. The llm server is not used.

tools.name: decision.config
tools.description: Show one decision model's catalog entry and, for a weight, its GGUF header.

tools.name: decision.usage
tools.description: Read recent decision probe and call rows from the home usage log. Rows have no prompt text.

tools.name: decision.download
tools.description: Download one GGUF from a Hugging Face repo into the shared library and add it to the host decision catalog. Refuses paths outside the home and files that would pass the disk reserve.

tools.name: decision.remove
tools.description: Remove one host-catalog decision model and its weight when no compound still names it. Does not edit the repo catalog.

tools.name: decision.sample
tools.description: Run the two short probes from home/policy.json on one decision model and at most two others. Does not start the router.
